readiness_issues.message: External benchmark inputs and import harness are ready, but real BioTransformer/MicrobeRX/GutBug-style outputs are not scored yet.
Wet-lab validation is not complete; public biological claims must stay limited.
Only internal research MVP deployment is allowed by this manifest.

biotransformer.input_note: BioTransformer accepts a tab-separated structure input where an identifier can precede a SMILES or InChI, and can also take SDF.
biotransformer.comparison_role: Product-generation comparator in Human Gut Microbial, SuperBio, or MultiBio modes.

microberx.input_note: MicrobeRX prediction is reaction-rule based; exported query and expected-product SMILES support product recall comparison after MicrobeRX runs.

gutbug.input_note: GutBug/GutBugDB focuses on EC/enzyme and strain predictions; PubChem CIDs are exported when resolvable.
gutbug.comparison_role: Enzyme/EC plausibility comparator rather than strict product-ranking comparator.

external_benchmark_export.claim_boundary: These are external benchmark inputs and expected-product labels; they are not external benchmark results.
external_benchmark_export.matching_key: case_id plus expected_product_inchikey/expected_product_block1 for product-output tools; case_id plus substrate_pubchem_cid for GutBug-style EC/enzyme tools.

external_result_scorecard.claim_boundary: External validation is not complete unless real external tool outputs are imported and scored.

metric_definitions.top5_hit_rate: Strict expected-product top-5 recall; connectivity hits with full-InChIKey mismatches are not counted.
metric_definitions.candidate_pool_recall: Fraction of cases where the expected product appears anywhere in the generated candidate pool.
metric_definitions.benchmark_traceability_rate: Fraction of cases where the expected product has any traceable benchmark or model evidence source.
metric_definitions.model_evidence_rate: Fraction of cases where matched output evidence is not limited to benchmark-panel labels.

current_claim: Internal research MVP for food-polyphenol candidate generation/ranking, strongest on glycoside aglycone release.
remaining_gap_to_full_food_microbiome_me: Challenge-panel failures are dominated by candidate-generation recall, not ranking.
Reaction-family coverage is still narrow for reductions, dehydroxylations, ring fission, decarboxylation, and multi-step gut microbial pathways.
Reaction-family KPI reporting is now available, but KPI strength is internal benchmark evidence only.
External tools have not yet been run on the exact same substrate panel.
No gene/genome or strain-level abundance context is connected to predictions.
Candidate generation still constrains the ceiling; ranking cannot recover products absent from the candidate set.
Model-output evidence coverage remains incomplete even when benchmark traceability is present.
